dashboard.label: Analyst Overview
dashboard.description: IOC matches summarized from your telemetry with drilldowns to raw events.

search.query: index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:* | fields _time sourcetype kind ioc score hits match_value ip hash url_candidate last_seen src_index created_by confidence labels | eval last_seen_str=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

| search sourcetype="opencti:file_hash_match" | eval indicator=coalesce(hash,ioc,match_value) | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by indicator | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:domain_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval domain=coalesce(match_value, fqdn, domain, ioc) | where isnotnull(domain) AND domain!="" | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by domain | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count
| search sourcetype="opencti:url_match" | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by url_candidate | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:ip_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by ip | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:email_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval email=lower(email) | stats latest(last_seen) as ls by email ioc score role | eval ls=tonumber(ls) | where ls>=relative_time(now(), "$time.earliest$") | stats count

index=opencti_alerts sourcetype=opencti:domain_match earliest=$time.earliest$ latest=$time.latest$ | eval domain=coalesce(match_value, fqdn, domain, ioc) | where isnotnull(domain) AND domain!="" | eval hits=if(isnum(hits), hits, 1) | stats sum(hits) as hits earliest(first_seen) as first_seen latest(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels values(threat_feed_at_match_time) as threat_feed_at_match_time values(created_by) as created_by max(confidence) as confidence by domain ioc | eval indicator=domain, type="domain", "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | lookup opencti_seenbefore_kv indicator,type OUTPUT ioc_rating decided_at decided_by note | eval Rating=coalesce(ioc_rating, "Unreviewed") | eval seen_again=if(isnotnull(decided_at) AND last_seen>decided_at, "Yes","No") | eval threat_feed_at_match_time=coalesce(threat_feed_at_match_time, created_by) | lookup opencti_threatfeed_current_domain ioc OUTPUT threat_feed_current feed_scores max_score min_score score_range | eval "Threat Feed At Match Time"=mvjoin(threat_feed_at_match_time, ", "), "Threat Feed Current"=mvjoin(threat_feed_current, ", ") | mvexpand feed_scores | eval _feed=mvindex(split(feed_scores, ":"), 0), _fscore=tonumber(mvindex(split(feed_scores, ":"), 1)) | eventstats max(_fscore) as _mx min(_fscore) as _mn by ioc | eval _max_by=if(_fscore=_mx, _feed, null()), _min_by=if(_fscore=_mn, _feed, null()) | stats max(hits) as hits min(first_seen) as first_seen max(last_seen) as last_seen latest(src_index) as src_index latest(labels) as labels max(confidence) as confidence values(Rating) as Rating values(note) as note values("Threat Feed At Match Time") as "Threat Feed At Match Time" values("Threat Feed Current") as "Threat Feed Current" max(_mx) as max_score min(_mn) as low_score values(_max_by) as "Max Score By" values(_min_by) as "Low Score By" by domain ioc | eval "Low Score"=low_score, "Max Score"=max_score, "Score Range"=low_score . "–" . max_score | eval "Last Time Seen"=strftime(last_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"), "First Time Seen"=strftime(first_seen, "%d %b %Y %H:%M:%S") | rename domain AS Domain labels AS Tags confidence AS Confidence hits AS "Times Seen" src_index AS Index | table Rating Domain "Times Seen" Tags "Low Score" "Low Score By" "Max Score" "Max Score By" "Score Range" "Threat Feed At Match Time" "Threat Feed Current" Confidence note "First Time Seen" "Last Time Seen" Index | rename note AS Notes | sort - hits | head 20
